name: Xusheng Luo
title: Assistant Professor
fitReason: ENAP (RSS 2026) discovers symbolic task structure from visuomotor demonstrations and combines it with a residual continuous-control policy. The CoRL 2026 behavior-steering extension reconfigures learned task structure at inference time.

physicalEvidence.summary: ENAP’s primary paper names a real Kinova Gen3 using base/wrist cameras on Lego stacking, color-matched pick/place and hanger placement. Its low-level policy uses frozen DINOv2 features and a residual network; the physical benchmarks are distinct from the simulated Panda suite.

shortVisit.summary: The current prospective-student page explicitly addresses students and visitors through an interest form and provides an email fallback. It advertises degree starts in Spring/Fall 2027, but gives no summer visitor duration or confirmed eight-week place.

scoreReasons.physical: Real Kinova Gen3 experiments were performed during the prior CMU affiliation; new NC State lab platform continuity is unconfirmed.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Explicit visitor inquiry but no duration or summer-specific terms.

name: Pratap Tokekar
title: Associate Professor
department: Computer Science; UMIACS; affiliated Electrical and Computer Engineering
fitReason: PRISM (2026) generates multimodal actions in a single pass using a multisensory temporal encoder and Performer architecture. Sketch-to-Skill (RSS 2025) uses human trajectory drawings to bootstrap manipulation learning. These are concrete robot-learning projects within the broader sensing/coordination lab.

physicalEvidence.summary: PRISM’s primary paper explicitly evaluates a Unitree Go2 with D1 arm and a UR5 on physical loco-manipulation, insertion and pick/place. The RSS 2025 Sketch-to-Skill paper independently documents a UR3e with Robotiq Hand-E on button and toast manipulation tasks.

shortVisit.summary: Current lab and faculty pages establish active research and master’s mentoring precedent, but no explicit external short-term master’s visitor invitation was found. UMD institutional visitor categories do not establish this mentor’s availability.

scoreReasons.fit: Strong multisensory, sample-efficient and human-guided manipulation learning.
scoreReasons.physical: Named robot learning experiments include a MERL collaboration; current UMD-local access is unconfirmed.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: No current external short visitor invitation; policy/mentoring precedent not scored.
scoreReasons.freshness: February 2026 primary hardware paper and September 2026 lab activity.
